chunks: My father narrated (may God be pleased with him) who said: Abdullah ibn Ja'far al-Humayri narrated from Ibrahim ibn Mahzar, from his brother Ali ibn Mahzar, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Muhammad ibn Hakim, from Maymun al-Banna', from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
Five [signs] before the rising of the Riser: the emergence of al-Yamani, and al-Sufyani, and the caller who calls from the heaven, and the land-sliding of al-Bayda', and the killing of the Pure Soul.

key_terms.السُّفْيَانِي: Al-Sufyani, a tyrannical figure who will emerge as a sign
key_terms.النَّفْسُ الزَّكِيَّةُ: The Pure Soul, a specific individual who will be martyred
key_terms.الْقَائِمُ: The Riser (al-Qa'im), a title for the Mahdi
key_terms.الْمُنَادِي: The Caller, a divine voice from heaven
key_terms.الْيَمَانِي: Al-Yamani, a specific figure who will emerge as a sign
key_terms.خَسْفُ الْبَيْدَاءَ: The land-sliding of al-Bayda', a miraculous event in the desert

ai.seo_question: What are the five major signs before the appearance of the Mahdi?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Saduq’s *al-Khisal*, this hadith outlines the five pivotal eschatological events preceding the reappearance of Imam al-Mahdi, emphasizing the cosmic and terrestrial upheavals that mark the end of the current age. The inclusion of al-Yamani and al-Sufyani highlights the dual forces of guidance and tyranny, while the martyrdom of Nafs al-Zakiyya serves as a crucial transitional event that purifies the faithful before the global establishment of justice. These signs are viewed in Shia tradition as inevitable divine decrees that prepare humanity for the ultimate triumph of truth.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 5-83 (The compiler of the book narrated) that his father - may God be pleased with him - narrated that Abdullah ibn Ja’far al-Homayry quoted Ibrahim ibn Mahzyar, on the authority of his brother Ali ibn Mahzyar, on the authority of Al-Hussein ibn Sa’id, on the authority of Safvan ibn Yahya, on the authority of Muhammad ibn Hakim, on the authority of Maymun al-Ban that Aba Abdullah as-Sadiq (MGB) said,

“There following five are the signs before the coming of the Riser (MGB): the appearance of al-Yamani; the appearance of al-Sufyani; the appearance of the caller from the heavens who calls out; land-sliding in al-Beyda and the murder of Nafs-i-Zakiya .”
